name: Duelist Kingdom rules
author: DecompRecomp
description: Rules from the anime's Duelist Kingdom: one card drawn a turn after the opening five, a hand of up to forty, turn phases with a second Main Phase, Petit Moth's evolution, and no card lost to a fusion that does not work. Needs Extra hand plays.

settings.label: Playing a card is optional
settings.description: START in the first hand of a turn plays no card and goes on to the field, as in the anime. Without it a full field with nothing that fuses would leave no legal play.

settings.label: Turn phases
settings.description: START opens a menu of the next phases: from the hand (Main Phase 1) the Battle Phase or the End Phase; from the field the Main Phase 2, to play from the hand again after attacking, or the End Phase. The CPU plays as before.

settings.label: Draw one card a turn
settings.description: Each side opens with five cards, then draws one a turn (none on the first turn of the side that goes first). The hand holds up to forty. Off refills the hand to five each turn, as on the disc.

settings.label: Keep cards a fusion cannot use
settings.description: Cards put onto a monster must fuse with it or equip it, and marked cards must all fuse or equip in that order, so no card is thrown away. The player's confirm is refused; the CPU plays elsewhere, or no card.

settings.label: Petit Moth's evolution (anime)
settings.description: Cocoon of Evolution put onto Petit Moth, or the two fused from the hand, makes the cocoon, in defense. At its owner's 4th turn after, it becomes Great Moth; at the 6th, Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth. Destroyed before, it is over. A Cocoon played alone stays a Cocoon.
